main.description: Start a Baien (BitNet b1.58) LoRA-on-bf16-master fine-tune (ADR 2605092350). Trains an adapter on the bf16 master checkpoint of the BitNet trunk; the post-train re-quantization to i2_s ternary is handled inside the runner. Same H100 NVL training pod as Oka — kind='baien-lora' is the only handler-side dispatch difference. baseModel defaults to microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 when omitted.

baseModel.description: HF model id; defaults to microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 (BAIEN_DEFAULT_TRUNK_MODEL).

requantizeAfterTrain.description: If true, re-quantize merged adapter+master to i2_s and record the ternary blob alongside the bf16 checkpoint.

perplexityDriftCeiling.description: Max allowed perplexity drift vs unquantized master on a held-out set (default 0.05 = 5%).

i2sBlobUri.description: B2 URI of the i2_s ternary-packed blob produced by re-quantization, if requantizeAfterTrain was true.

perplexityDrift.description: Measured perplexity drift vs unquantized master on the held-out set.
